subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman shown in <Picture 1> from front close-up, full-front, side profile, and back views. She has dark brown wavy hair styled in two side ponytails, each tied with a large pastel pink satin bow; the left bow holds a small pink plush bunny charm with a trailing cord. She has large expressive brown eyes, fair skin, and soft natural makeup. She wears a white lace-trimmed camisole top, a cropped light pink short-sleeve cardigan, a high-waisted light grey pleated mini skirt, white knee-high socks, and pastel pink platform sneakers with white soles. Her overall look is soft, cute, and pastel J-pop idol aesthetic. <Picture 1> establishes her appearance from multiple angles so she remains consistent when she turns, dances, or is viewed from the side/back.

<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]–[Shot 4]): fully_preserved - side ponytails with large pastel pink bows and pink plush bunny charm, white lace-trimmed camisole, cropped light pink cardigan, light grey pleated mini skirt, white knee-high socks, pink platform sneakers with white soles, fair skin, large brown eyes, soft cute-idol styling, and her singing/cute expressions are retained throughout. <Picture 1>'s front/side/back views ensure consistency when she spins, turns, or the camera circles her.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] At 00:00.000 — Medium shot (waist-up), the establishing frame keeps <Subject 1> (S1) framed from the waist up against a soft pink sky at golden hour, with drifting clouds and a gentle shower of cherry blossom petals behind her. She faces the camera with a sweet, slightly shy smile, one hand resting over her heart. Soft volumetric light wraps her upper body. The camera slowly pushes in as she begins to sing the opening line with clear, bright, slightly breathy enunciation, lips forming the words "我把好心情 偷偷预约了明天", then lifts her other hand toward the lens with fingers loosely open, as if reaching for the viewer. Petals fall in slow motion past her face; her pastel-pink bows and the bunny charm sway gently with the motion.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.750 — Medium close-up (chest-up), the camera tracking slightly around her left side and staying framed on her upper body. <Subject 1> (S1) begins the dance with a gentle upper-body groove: she sways her shoulders to the beat, then forms a small heart with her thumbs and index fingers and holds it up near the camera. She sings "折一只纸船 载着小小的心愿" with a light, cheerful lift at the end of each phrase, the pink bows in her hair bouncing with the motion and the plush bunny charm swinging from the trailing cord. The camera dollies in closer as she tilts her head and blinks slowly; sparkles and soft lens flare bloom around her. Cherry blossom petals swirl in the air behind her shoulders, caught by a light breeze.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.500 — Medium close-up (waist-up), the camera stays framed on her upper body as <Subject 1> (S1) dances with more energy. She raises both arms in a flowing wave, sways her shoulders in rhythm, and turns her head to glance over her shoulder with a bright smile for one beat before facing front again. She sings "风一吹就转圈 啦啦啦～好甜", the "啦啦啦" bright and airy, her melody bouncing with the motion. Soft pink glow and cherry blossom petals drift behind her shoulders. The camera gently orbits 120 degrees while keeping her framed waist-up, revealing her profile and the back of her head with the pink bows, then settles facing her as she completes the turn.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.250 — Medium close-up (chest-up), slow push-in. <Subject 1> (S1) faces the camera straight on, the background dissolving into a soft bokeh of pink petals and clouds. She sings the closing line "预约的快乐 今天先见面" with a warm, satisfied little smile, then winks with her right eye, brings both hands together beside her cheek in a cute pose, and blows a small kiss toward the lens. A cluster of petals drifts across the foreground. The image glows with warm golden-hour bloom and tiny sparkles; her brown eyes are bright and expressive. The camera holds for a final beat as she settles into a soft, confident smile, then fades to white sparkle at 00:10.000.

overall_soundscape:
A light breeze rustles through cherry blossom petals and the loose ends of <Subject 1>'s (S1) bows; her sneakers tap softly on the white platform; distant airy chimes and a faint shimmer tone accent the sparkles. Her clear, cute singing voice carries the Chinese lyrics with bright reverb.

non_diegetic_music:
Upbeat pastel synth-pop with bright arpeggiated synthesizers, a steady four-on-the-floor kick, a bouncy bass line, and a clear, bright, slightly breathy cute female lead vocal singing the Chinese lyrics (light major-key melody, cheerful and childlike). Bell tones and a gentle string pad enter around [Shot 2]; the string pad swells during [Shot 4] as the final line resolves.
